The issuer shows fairly low liquidity (current ratio of 1.18), indicating limited near-term cushion against current liabilities. However, profitability appears solid with EBIT of 577M on revenue of 2,444M (~24% margin), and equity (14,298M) is substantial versus total liabilities (26,603M), supporting repayment capacity. Overall, the weaker liquidity and leverage keep the credit quality in the lower investment-grade range.  
DECISION: BBB-
